blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas’ Khy Progella and Sofiah Pagara saw their gold medal hopes end after a heartbreaking 21-23, 18-21 loss to Thailand in the Asian Games women’s beach volleyball semifinal on Thursday at Hekinan Ryokuchi Beach Court. Progella and Pagara were two points away from taking the first set with a 19-15 lead, but Thailand’s Taravadee Naraphonapat and Worapeerachayakorn Kongphopsarutawadee dug deep to take a 20-19 advantage. The Filipinos saved two set points, but Naraphonapat struck to close out the set–the first one the young Alas duo […]...
